subject: Cannot Open Shinyapps.io Correctly Due to the Conection to jQuery Mirrow of Google

messages.author: 3055471c1db79df6
messages.subject: Cannot Open Shinyapps.io Correctly Due to the Conection to jQuery Mirrow of Google
parts:
Hi Shinyapps.io Team. Thanks so much for bringing us the GREAT shiny project!

I just have a problem accessing Shinyapps,io, and go here to see whether I can get help.

These days, Almost all Google's domain have been banned in China from June 3,including the Google's jQuery hosting mirrow. Maybe it will be a looong time for the restriction go down. Because government of China have found so many evidences of eavesdropping to Chinese company and people last few days.

Shinyapps.io is using https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/2.0.3/jquery.min.map and many more links to Google, so I have to used a proxy to get the "show screct" icon work in the browser. And the time loading the website is very long, because of Google web fonts and other Google's stuff.
Shinyapps.io is not banned from China, it will be convenient for those script and web font to be hosted in Shinyapps.io.

And also hope to see the issue of Sys.setlocale(locale="English") can be solved soon.

Best Regards,
Wenfeng

We will work on moving things off of Google. I'm not sure when it will be complete, but probably by sometime next week.

Cheers
-Andy
